name: team-health-check

scripts.test:a11y: npm run build && playwright test e2e/accessibility.spec.ts

_overrides_note: Transitive pins for advisories with no non-breaking upstream fix; npm offered only a major Prisma downgrade for each. deepmerge-ts: @prisma/config pins 7.1.5, stack exhaustion on recursive graphs (GHSA-ggr8-5vv4-36mx). mysql2: reached through @prisma/client -> prisma and never loaded here, since this app uses SQLite and Turso (GHSA-3f6p-5ww8-9rcr, GHSA-rgwj-5xj2-c3m3). baseline-browser-mapping: browserslist data pulled in by next (GHSA-w5vr-8v7q-w6rv). All four are exercised by the gates -- the E2E suite runs prisma migrate through @prisma/config, and the build resolves browserslist data. browserslist: reached through eslint-config-next -> eslint-plugin-react-hooks -> @babel/core, so lint-time only; unbounded memory growth via distinct query results and a prototype write via an untrusted browserslist-stats.json this repo does not have (GHSA-c83g-rgw3-j3cx, GHSA-73wf-gq98-2v4g). 4.29.1 satisfies the declared ^4.24.0 and needs no ESLint 10 upgrade, but npm audit fix and npm update both decline to apply it -- the existing resolution already satisfies every declared range, so fixAvailable only means a patched version exists in the registry. fast-uri: authority injection via an unvalidated port, and host confusion via an unclosed bracket, both in URI serialisation (GHSA-qw65-cvwx-89v3, GHSA-58mr-gqgx-xq4g). Reached through prisma -> @prisma/dev -> @prisma/streams-local -> ajv, which is the CLI's own tooling: it runs migrate and generate, and no route imports it. prisma is a devDependency here, and npm audit --omit=dev still reports it because @prisma/client declares prisma as an optional peer, which makes the whole CLI tree production-reachable from a production package -- npm ls renders that edge as @prisma/client -> prisma, which reads like a real dependency and is not one. 3.1.8 is the first patched release and satisfies the ^3.0.1 ajv declares. sharp: a librsvg vulnerability reached through next, which declares it as an optional dependency at ^0.35.4 (CVE-2026-96889, GHSA-wq5f-xc86-pv6w); 0.35.5 is the patched release. source-map-js: event-loop denial of service via indexed source-map section offsets (GHSA-68fv-2mgg-jv7q), reached twice -- next -> postcss, and @prisma/client -> prisma -> @prisma/config -> c12 -> magicast, both declaring ^1.2.1, with 1.2.2 patched. Neither is fixed by moving to next 16.4.0, which was checked rather than assumed: it still resolves sharp 0.35.4 and source-map-js 1.2.1. Drop each one once its parent depends on a patched version itself.
